title: KeebColab
tagline: NFTs that bring people together, that tell a story, your story, my story, our story.
description: Forget Fiverr, forget Zapier, and leave your preconception of freelance, collaboration, and"gig economy" at the door.  Keeb Colabs brings people together without getting in the way.   We are going to leverage the new economics of blockchain to provide a cheap and reliable way to link the story to the product.  We are going to use nft.storage because they are already offering 32GB on a single token (in ten years it may be 1000TB.  That's a big story!)  And we are going to use NFTPort to mint because they make it easy.  We would really like to use Covalent instead of thegraph, because they have a better business model.  And we would like to make good use of Fluence as it provides many of the features needed to scale this idea.  And I could go on, but there's no more space...
